goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet-squat.setup: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest. Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
goblet-squat.move: Sit down between your knees until your thighs are about parallel, then stand up.
goblet-squat.breathe: In on the way down, out as you stand.
goblet-squat.mistake: Knees caving inward or heels lifting.

db-bench.name: Dumbbell bench press
db-bench.setup: Lie on the bench, a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, feet flat on the floor.
db-bench.move: Press the weights up until your arms are straight, then lower slowly.
db-bench.breathe: In as you lower, out as you press.
db-bench.mistake: Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.
db-bench.cue: Elbows about 45 degrees from your body.

db-row.name: One-arm dumbbell row
db-row.setup: One hand and one knee on the bench (or a chair), flat back, dumbbell in the free hand.
db-row.move: Pull the weight to your hip, pause, lower slowly.
db-row.breathe: Out as you pull, in as you lower.
db-row.mistake: Twisting your body to swing the weight up.
db-row.cue: Pull your elbow to your back pocket.

db-ohp.name: Dumbbell overhead press
db-ohp.setup: Stand or sit tall, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
db-ohp.move: Press overhead until your arms are straight, then lower to shoulders.
db-ohp.breathe: Out as you press, in as you lower.
db-ohp.mistake: Leaning back and arching the lower back.

plank.name: Plank
plank.setup: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders, legs straight behind you.
plank.move: Hold a straight line from head to heels.
plank.breathe: Slow, steady breaths. Don't hold your breath.

db-rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
db-rdl.setup: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent.
db-rdl.move: Push your hips back, slide the weights down your legs, then stand tall.
db-rdl.breathe: In as you lower, out as you stand.
db-rdl.cue: Hips back like closing a car door.

incline-pushup.name: Incline push-up
incline-pushup.setup: Hands on a bench or sturdy table, body in a straight line.
incline-pushup.move: Lower your chest to the edge, then push away.
incline-pushup.breathe: In as you lower, out as you push.

lat-pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
lat-pulldown.setup: Sit with thighs under the pad, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
lat-pulldown.move: Pull the bar to your upper chest, then let it rise slowly.
lat-pulldown.breathe: Out as you pull, in as it rises.
lat-pulldown.cue: Pull elbows down to your sides.

db-curl.name: Dumbbell curl
db-curl.setup: Stand tall, a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
db-curl.move: Curl up without swinging, then lower slowly.
db-curl.breathe: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

dead-bug.name: Dead bug
dead-bug.setup: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent over hips.
dead-bug.move: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly, return, switch sides.
dead-bug.breathe: Out as you extend, in as you return.
dead-bug.mistake: Lower back lifting off the floor.

split-squat.name: Dumbbell split squat
split-squat.setup: One foot forward, one back, dumbbells at your sides.
split-squat.move: Lower your back knee toward the floor, then drive up.

calf-raise.name: Calf raise
calf-raise.setup: Stand on the edge of a step or flat ground, holding something for balance.
calf-raise.move: Rise onto your toes, pause, lower slowly.
calf-raise.breathe: Out as you rise, in as you lower.
